detail.longDescription: New hVmark "Patch": v1.8.5 Added the ability to separately set the alt text and captions of images. Yeah, there's been a lot of "patches" lately, but nothing that felt like they warranted their own minor release, despite how transformative these "patches" have been. https:// github.com/HisVirusness/hvmark hVmark is my tiny, opinionated markup language: MIT-licensed, intentionally strict, and built to power HisVirusness.com. # markup # markdown # hVmark # webdev # php # indieweb # smallweb
